title: Lotus Temple
visualBrief: Specific Lotus Temple exterior:27 curved petal shells in three ninefold groups, open porch arches, raised red/white base with continuous glazing bands, nine stepped/ramped approaches and nine independently mapped pools. Fine panel joints, exact shell engineering, hidden interiors and landscaping are omitted.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q940843/way44827278 identifies the principal building. Standard PMTiles building35184416916110 and18 independent roof-part outlines establish the70m plan and ninefold rhythm. Nine mapped water polygons establish the pool layout. The main approach is chosen along the southwest garden corridor; the radial building has nine related entrances. Pointed shell arches face the mapped radial approach gaps; individual shell phase is picture-guided with up to20degrees uncertainty.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No architectural heights in the retained mapped controls. The34.5m upper shell elevation,24.3m intermediate tips,11.2m outer tips,4.4m platform, shell thickness and stair counts are picture-guided estimates.
